Variants.Content: The surface of the swamp appears to be flat, but is actually covered with soft mud, dark water, insect swarms, and moving safe paths. The Ningze people rely on canoes, wooden roads and local memories to travel; once the heavily armored cavalry and baggage vehicles leave the causeway, their speed and combat effectiveness will quickly disappear.
